node.title: Re: Calling a remote ssh connection from perl (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
In addition to what [LanX] said, [doc://system] doesn't capture the output of the command. I very strongly recommend you use [mod://Net::OpenSSH] instead. (And as for running external commands, see [id://1180578].)

Update: You've replaced your question with a different one. Please read [id://17557|It is uncool to update a node in a way that renders replies confusing or meaningless].
